tincoats/bowling

pin: f3ef2da813cac5874c85019f86243bcacbad2a46
MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 scotty888

Upstream is an ES-module demo (Babylon.js + Havok, a glTF pin, type=module).
GifOS inlines <script src> as classic scripts and drops type=module, so that
engine cannot ride in. layout.js keeps the alley numbers and the throw from
main.js at the pin above:

  lane 6 wide, ball at (0, -7) diameter 1.5 mass 2
  pin triangle at z = 10,11,12,13
  drag left/right moves the ball (clamp ±2.5, 0.02 world per pixel)
  flick up the lane: dy > 30px, under 1s, more vertical than horizontal
  impulse = min(40, 20 + dy/8) along +z

Scoring, take-turns, and the canvas alley are the GifOS port. Original had
no score sheet — it reloaded the page seven seconds after a throw.
